comparison.objective: Position a nickel strip on four battery cells and spot-weld every terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip placement plus repeated two-probe alignment and contact dwell.
comparison.success_condition: The strip is aligned, four weld contacts are completed, the welder is returned, and the pack is not upset; real welds additionally require a pull test.
comparison.reason: This tests sheet placement and repeated welding-contact registration, not rotary commissioning or dynamic stop adjustment. Both use tool alignment, but the mechanisms and outcomes differ.
